_comment: Minecraft 1.4.7 modpack servers compiled with GraalVM native-image. One egg for every port in this repo; pick the pack with the Modpack variable.
name: Minecraft 1.4.7 modpack (GraalVM native)
author: thatnerd64
description: FTB Direwolf20 5.3.2 or FTB Ultimate 1.1.2 (Minecraft 1.4.7, Forge) server compiled ahead of time with GraalVM native-image. No JVM. Installs the prebuilt release from github.com/thatnerd64/experimental-optimization-mc.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs the repo's install.sh, which downloads the release bundle for $PACK, checks its SHA-256 and unpacks it into /mnt/server.
# Reinstalling updates the binary, libraries and mods and keeps worlds, server.properties and config/.
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates tar coreutils >/dev/null
curl -fsSL "${INSTALLER_URL}" -o /tmp/install.sh
sh /tmp/install.sh "${PACK}" /mnt/server

variables.name: Modpack
variables.description: Which port to install: direwolf20 (Direwolf20 5.3.2) or ftb-ultimate (FTB Ultimate 1.1.2). Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Heap (MB)
variables.description: -Xmx for the native image. Keep it below the server memory limit (about 75%). The servers idle around 300 MB.

variables.name: Online mode
variables.description: true = verify accounts with Mojang (1.4.7 auth is long gone, so test servers use false).

variables.name: Installer URL
variables.description: The install.sh the install script runs.
